resources.string: Jumping Jacks

string-array.name: ex_jumping_jacks_instructions
string-array.item: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out to shoulder width while raising your hands above your head.
Jump back to the starting position, landing softly on the balls of your feet.

resources.string: Inhale as you open up, exhale as you close your body.
Landing hard on your heels; always cushion the landing with slightly bent knees.
Mountain Climbers

string-array.name: ex_mountain_climbers_instructions
string-array.item: Start in a high plank with your hands directly under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest without lifting your hips.
Alternate legs quickly with an explosive, rhythmic motion.

resources.string: Keep your breathing rhythmic and continuous, never holding your breath.
Letting your hips rise too high or your lower back sag.
High Knees

string-array.name: ex_high_knees_instructions
string-array.item: Run in place, driving your knees up to hip height.
Keep your chest tall and swing your arms with the movement.
Land softly on the balls of your feet at a fast rhythm.

resources.string: Inhale for two steps, exhale for two steps.
Leaning backward as you lift your legs.
Dynamic Burpees

string-array.name: ex_burpees_instructions
string-array.item: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position.
Jump your feet back toward your hands and jump up, extending your arms.

resources.string: Exhale on the way up, inhale as you lower back to the floor.
Arching your lower back as you jump your feet back.
Knee Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_push_ups_knees_instructions
string-array.item: Rest on your knees with your palms slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees, bracing your core.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows at 45 degrees, then push up hard.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower your chest, exhale as you push up.
Letting your head drop or overextending your neck.
Classic Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_push_ups_standard_instructions
string-array.item: Get into a high plank with your feet together and your core tight.
Lower yourself under control until your chest is a few inches off the floor.
Push the floor away and extend your arms without snapping your elbows.

resources.string: Inhale on the way down, exhale as you push up powerfully.
Flaring your elbows 90 degrees out from your torso; they should form an arrow (45°).
Diamond Push-Ups (Chest & Triceps)

string-array.name: ex_push_ups_diamond_instructions
string-array.item: Bring your thumbs and index fingers together on the floor to form a triangle or diamond under your chest.
Lower the center of your chest toward the center of your hands, keeping your elbows tucked.
Push up, squeezing the inner chest and your triceps.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.
Doing short bounces instead of completing the full range of motion.
Crunches

string-array.name: ex_crunches_instructions
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet firmly on the floor.
Place your hands behind your ears without pulling on your neck.
Lift your shoulder blades by squeezing your abs hard, then lower with control.

resources.string: Exhale as you lift and contract your core, inhale as your shoulders come down.
Pulling on your head with your hands and straining your neck.
Isometric Plank

string-array.name: ex_plank_instructions
string-array.item: Rest on your forearms and the balls of your feet.
Form one perfect straight line from your head to your heels.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your navel toward your spine without dropping your hips.

resources.string: Breathe slowly and deeply, never holding your breath.
Letting your lower back sag or hiking your hips into a triangle.
Bicycle Crunches

string-array.name: ex_bicycle_crunches_instructions
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your legs raised at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee as you extend your right leg.
Alternate sides smoothly, rotating from your ribcage.

resources.string: Exhale on every cross with a diagonal contraction.
Moving only your elbows instead of rotating your whole torso.
Classic Squats

string-array.name: ex_squats_bodyweight_instructions
string-array.item: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes slightly turned out.
Bend your hips and knees as if you were sitting down in a low chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive back up through your heels.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale forcefully as you stand up.
Letting your knees cave inward or your heels lift off the floor.
Alternating Lunges

string-array.name: ex_lunges_alternating_instructions
string-array.item: Take a long step forward with one leg, keeping your torso upright.
Bend both knees until they form a 90-degree angle.
Push through your front heel to return to the start and switch legs.

resources.string: Inhale as you step down, exhale as you return to center.
Letting your front knee travel far past your toes.
Glute & Hamstring Bridge

string-array.name: ex_glute_bridge_instructions
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat close to your glutes.
Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes until knees, hips and shoulders are aligned.
Hold for 1 second at the top and lower slowly without fully touching the floor.

resources.string: Exhale as you lift your hips, inhale as you lower.
Arching your lower back instead of extending your hips with your glutes.
Wall Sit

string-array.name: ex_wall_sit_instructions
string-array.item: Press your back flat against a wall and slide down.
Stop when your thighs form a 90-degree angle with the floor.
Rest your hands on your thighs or let them hang at your sides and hold the position.

resources.string: Breathe calmly and keep your core tight.
Resting your hands on your knees to take load off your legs.
Triceps Dips

string-array.name: ex_triceps_dips_instructions
string-array.item: Place your palms on a sturdy chair, sofa or on the floor behind you.
With your elbows pointing back, bend them and lower your hips close to the support.
Push through your palms, extending your arms and squeezing your triceps.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower your body, exhale as you extend your arms.
Moving your back away from the support or shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
Superman Back Extension

string-array.name: ex_superman_instructions
string-array.item: Lie face down with your arms and legs fully extended.
Lift your chest, arms and thighs a few inches off the floor at the same time.
Squeeze your lower back and glutes at the top, then lower gently.

resources.string: Inhale on the floor, exhale as you lift your limbs.
Straining your neck to look up instead of keeping your gaze on the floor.
Cobra & Back Extension

string-array.name: ex_cobra_stretch_instructions
string-array.item: Lie face down with your palms on the floor beside your chest.
Push gently, extending your torso upward and opening your chest.
Move your shoulders away from your ears and feel your back decompress.

resources.string: Inhale deeply as you open your ribcage, exhale as you release the tension.
Locking your elbows abruptly if you feel discomfort in your lower back.
Wall Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_wall_push_ups_instructions
string-array.item: Place your palms on the wall at shoulder height, a little wider than your shoulders.
Take a step back and keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, then push back without locking your elbows.

resources.string: Inhale as you move toward the wall, exhale as you push away.
Letting your hips drop or shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
Triceps Dips on the Floor

string-array.name: ex_triceps_dips_floor_instructions
string-array.item: Sit on the edge of a stable chair with your hands beside your hips and your fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the seat with your legs extended and your back close to the chair.
Lower by bending your elbows back to about 90 degrees, then push to come back up.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.
Moving your back away from the seat or shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
Kneeling Triceps Extension

string-array.name: ex_kneeling_triceps_extension_instructions
string-array.item: Kneel with your hands on the floor under your shoulders and your fingers pointing forward.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees with your core tight.
Bend your elbows back to lower your chest, then push to extend your arms.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower your chest, exhale as you extend your elbows.
Flaring your elbows out instead of keeping them close to your torso.
Self-Resistance Biceps Curl

string-array.name: ex_biceps_self_resistance_instructions
string-array.item: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head resting on your lower arm.
Keep your top arm against your side and bend your elbow, bringing your hand toward your shoulder.
Press your other hand against your forearm to slow the descent, then repeat.

resources.string: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower with control.
Moving your shoulder or torso to help your arm; only your elbow should be working.
Close-Grip Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_close_grip_push_ups_instructions
string-array.item: Get into a high plank with your hands together under your chest and your core tight.
Lower your body, keeping your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the plank.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push.
Flaring your elbows out, which takes work off your triceps and loads your shoulder.
Elbow Dips on a Chair

string-array.name: ex_elbow_dips_instructions
string-array.item: Sit on the edge of a stable chair and grip the edge with your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips forward and place your heels on the floor with your knees slightly bent.
Lower by bending your elbows, then push until your arms straighten without locking out fully.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.
Going too low and feeling pressure in your shoulder; stop at about a 90-degree elbow angle.
Side Triceps Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_side_push_up_instructions
string-array.item: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked one on top of the other.
Place your lower hand under your shoulder and push to lift your hips off the floor.
Raise your free arm toward the ceiling in a straight line and lower with control. Switch sides halfway through.

resources.string: Exhale as you lift your hips, inhale as you lower.
Letting your hips drop or drifting your support shoulder in front of your hand.
Elevated Triceps Dips

string-array.name: ex_body_up_instructions
string-array.item: Place your palms on a sturdy bench or the edge of a stable table, with your fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs in front of you with your heels on the floor and keep your body straight.
Lower by bending your elbows close to your body, then push through your palms to rise.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push hard.
Using an unstable surface or letting your hips drop for lack of core tension.
Standing Towel Row

string-array.name: ex_towel_row_instructions
string-array.item: Hold a rolled towel with both hands in front of your chest, feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge your torso forward, keeping your back straight.
Pull the towel toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

resources.string: Exhale as you pull the towel, inhale as you extend your arms.
Rounding your back or hunching your neck as you squeeze your shoulder blades.
Prone Elbow Lift

string-array.name: ex_prone_elbow_lift_instructions
string-array.item: Lie face down with your legs extended and your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and push gently with your palms to lift your chest off the floor.
Draw your elbows back by squeezing your shoulder blades, hold for a second, then lower slowly.

resources.string: Exhale as you squeeze your shoulder blades, inhale as you lower.
Arching your lower back or lifting your head too high; the movement comes from your upper back.
Scapular Push-Ups

string-array.name: ex_scapula_push_up_instructions
string-array.item: Get into a high plank with your arms straight and your core tight.
Without bending your elbows, let your chest sink as your shoulder blades spread apart.
Push the floor away to rise and squeeze your shoulder blades together. The range is short and controlled.

resources.string: Inhale as your chest sinks, exhale as you push.
Bending your elbows and turning it into a regular push-up.
Sphinx Hold

string-array.name: ex_sphinx_hold_instructions
string-array.item: Lie face down with your forearms on the floor and your elbows under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and lift your chest off the floor without shrugging your shoulders.
Hold the position, breathing calmly with your neck in a neutral position.

resources.string: Breathe deeply and slowly, never holding your breath.
Letting your lower back sag or looking too far up.
Towel Squat Row

string-array.name: ex_towel_squat_row_instructions
string-array.item: Holding the towel in your hands, lower into a half squat with your chest up.
From there, pull the towel toward your chest, drawing your elbows back.
Extend your arms and stand up out of the squat to complete the rep.

resources.string: Exhale as you pull and stand up, inhale as you lower.
Losing your lower-back curve as you lean or pulling only with your arms.
Inverted Row Under a Sturdy Table

string-array.name: ex_inverted_row_table_instructions
string-array.item: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Place your heels on the floor with your knees slightly bent and your body straight.
Pull on the edge to bring your chest toward the table, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower with control. Only use a stable table that won\'t tip over.

resources.string: Exhale as your chest rises, inhale as you lower.
Using unstable tables or letting your hips drop; if the table moves, switch exercises.
Reverse Plank with Leg Lift

string-array.name: ex_reverse_plank_leg_lift_instructions
string-array.item: Sit with your knees bent and your palms on the floor behind your hips.
Push through your hands and feet to lift your hips into a straight line.
From the top, lift one straight leg and lower your hips to repeat, alternating sides.

resources.string: Exhale as you lift your hips, inhale as you lower.
Letting your head fall back or locking your elbows with tension.
Upward Dog

string-array.name: ex_upward_dog_instructions
string-array.item: Lie face down with your legs extended and your hands beside your lower ribs.
Push the floor away to lift your torso and thighs, opening your chest.
Draw your shoulders back and down, hold for a few seconds, then lower slowly.

resources.string: Inhale as you open your chest, exhale as you lower.
Compressing your lower back; spread the stretch between your chest and upper back.
Overhead Stick Passes

string-array.name: ex_stick_shoulder_pass_instructions
string-array.item: Hold the stick with both hands, wider than shoulder width, in front of your thighs.
Raise the stick in front of you, pass it over your head and bring it behind your back without bending your elbows.
Reverse the path with control back to the starting position.

resources.string: Inhale as you raise the stick, exhale as you lower it behind you.
Arching your lower back or letting your hands fly open; if it feels tight, widen your grip.
Stick Torso Twists

string-array.name: ex_stick_torso_twist_instructions
string-array.item: Rest the stick across your shoulders, holding it with your hands and your elbows forward.
Turn your torso slowly to one side without moving your hips or feet.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

resources.string: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.
Turning only your arms or forcing your lower back; the twist starts at your chest.
Overhead Stick Press

string-array.name: ex_stick_overhead_press_instructions
string-array.item: Hold the stick in front of your chest with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Press the stick overhead until your arms are straight, without flaring your ribs.
Lower slowly to chest height, keeping your core tight.

resources.string: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
Arching your back or shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
Stick Side Bend

string-array.name: ex_stick_side_bend_instructions
string-array.item: With the stick overhead and your arms straight, widen your grip a little.
Bend your torso to one side, keeping your hips in place.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

resources.string: Exhale as you bend, inhale as you return to center.
Twisting your torso or lifting a foot; the movement is purely sideways.
Stick Good Mornings

string-array.name: ex_stick_good_morning_instructions
string-array.item: Place the stick across your upper back, holding it with your hands and your elbows open.
With your knees slightly bent, push your hips back while keeping your back straight.
Lower until you feel the stretch in your hamstrings, then come up by squeezing your glutes.

resources.string: Inhale as your hips go back, exhale as you rise.
Rounding your back or bending your knees like in a squat.
Stick Back Squat

string-array.name: ex_stick_back_squat_instructions
string-array.item: Rest the stick across your shoulder blades, holding it at the sides with your hands.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart and push your hips back.
Keep your chest high and drive up through your heels.

resources.string: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you rise.
Losing contact between the stick and your back or letting your knees cave in.
Stick Shoulder Windmill

string-array.name: ex_stick_shoulder_windmill_instructions
string-array.item: Hold the stick vertically with one hand, resting it on the floor or at hip height.
With your arm straight, draw a big circle with the stick forward and back.
Switch arms halfway through.

resources.string: Breathe continuously and follow the circle without locking your shoulder.
Moving your whole torso instead of your shoulder, or drawing circles so small they don\'t mobilize it.
Stick Woodchopper

string-array.name: ex_stick_woodchopper_instructions
string-array.item: Hold the stick with both hands diagonally above your right shoulder.
Bring the stick down toward your left hip, rotating your torso and bending your knees.
Come back up with control and switch sides halfway through.

resources.string: Exhale as you bring the stick down, inhale as you come back up.
Pulling only with your arms or snapping your hips around; spread the rotation through your whole torso.
Stick Wrist Rolls

string-array.name: ex_stick_wrist_rolls_instructions
string-array.item: Hold the stick at both ends with your palms facing down and your arms extended in front of you.
Roll the stick toward you with your wrists, then unroll it forward.
Alternate directions while keeping your elbows still.

resources.string: Breathe calmly and keep your shoulders down.
Moving your elbows or shrugging your shoulders; only your wrists should rotate.
Stick Knee Raises

string-array.name: ex_stick_knee_raise_instructions
string-array.item: Rest the stick across your shoulders, holding it with your hands, and keep your back straight.
Lift one knee to hip height without leaning back.
Lower your foot with control and repeat on the other leg at the same pace.

resources.string: Exhale as you lift your knee, inhale as you lower your foot.
Arching your back or leaning your torso back; keep your abs tight.
Ankle Circles

string-array.name: ex_warmup_ankle_circles_instructions
string-array.item: Steady yourself against a wall or light support with one foot slightly raised.
Circle your ankle in wide loops, 10 times in each direction.
Switch feet and repeat the movement with the same range.

resources.string: Breathe calmly and steadily; a warm-up should never wear you out.
Making very fast or tiny circles; mobility comes from range, not speed.
Wrist Circles

string-array.name: ex_warmup_wrist_circles_instructions
string-array.item: Extend your arms at shoulder height with your hands open.
Circle your wrists in wide loops, 10 times forward.
Do 10 circles backward, keeping your arms steady.

resources.string: Inhale and exhale with the rhythm of the circles, never holding your breath.
Moving only your fingers instead of rotating the whole wrist.
Standing Side Stretch

string-array.name: ex_warmup_lateral_stretch_instructions
string-array.item: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm and slowly lean your torso to the opposite side, feeling the stretch along your side.
Hold for 3 seconds, return to center and switch sides.

resources.string: Exhale as you lean to the side, inhale as you return to center.
Twisting your torso forward; the movement is purely lateral.
